purpose: Resolve repository paths to canonical architecture ownership and zones, and bind AI-tree source/destination mappings into the same ownership graph.

masterplan_bindings.title: System Architecture
required_gap_texts: automate owner lookup for newly created paths

masterplan_bindings.title: Repository Architecture
required_gap_texts: bind all AI roots to one ownership graph

policy.owner_resolution: Physical owner uses longest canonical-root path prefix. For a destination inside a declared migration:staged-mirror mapping, effective semantic owner inherits the mapping source owner until explicit cutover.
policy.zone_resolution: Physical zone uses longest zone-root path prefix. For a destination inside a declared migration:staged-mirror mapping, effective semantic zone inherits the mapping source zone until explicit cutover.
policy.ai_tree_rule: Every governed AI-tree source and destination resolves physically. Same-root mappings keep physical/effective identity. Cross-root or cross-zone mappings are legal only when explicitly tagged migration:staged-mirror with a cutover:* tag and non-empty source_disposition; their effective destination owner/zone must equal the source owner/zone.
policy.unknown_path_rule: Paths outside declared canonical roots and outside declared staged-mirror destination aliases have no production owner and fail lookup rather than inheriting ambient authority.
